If I can help you in any way, my young friend, it would…

Q00158_SeedOfEvil/30031-04.html.text: High Priest Biotin: You have not yet been able to eradicate that seed of evil , I see. Bear this in mind. It is in the deepest depths of the Elven Ruins , and takes the form of a great red devil with the wings of a bat. I bid you take caution.

Ah, it seems like only yesterday that you finished your studies and left to see the wide world. And here you are, all grown up, strong and straight as a reed. My heart sings to see you well! Thanks be to Einhasad! Hollint told …

Q00402_PathOfTheHumanKnight/30031-01.htm.text: High Priest Biotin: Now I see you were a squire. The church of Einhasad has always provided a restful place for pilgrims. Stay here and rest until your weary body and soul have recovered.
